title: AppConfig
description: Schema for txwatch TOML configuration files.

max_pages_per_cycle.description: Maximum Horizon pages (200 transactions each) fetched per contract in one poll cycle. Default: 10.

concurrency.description: Maximum number of contracts polled concurrently in one cycle (used by watch and watch --once). Default: 8. Maximum: 256.

state_file.description: Path to the JSON state file used to persist per-contract cursors and rule state across restarts. When unset, state is kept in memory only and cursors restart from the beginning on each run.

include.description: Glob patterns selecting additional TOML files to merge into this configuration (e.g. "contracts/*.toml"). Matched files are loaded and their [[contracts]] entries appended.

cooldown_summary.description: When true, log a summary of alerts suppressed by rule cooldowns at the end of each poll cycle. Default: false.

min_severity.description: Minimum severity an alert must have to be delivered. Alerts below this level are dropped before dispatch. Default: "info".

rule_types.description: Allowlist of rule type names (e.g. "LargeTransfer", "EventEmitted"). When set, only rules whose type appears in this list are evaluated; all others are skipped.

contracts.description: Watched contracts. Each entry defines a contract, its network, and the rules evaluated against its transactions and events.

concurrency.description: Maximum number of contracts polled concurrently in one cycle (used by watch and watch --once). Default: 10.

state_file.description: Path to the persisted watcher state file. Defaults to the platform state directory.

include.description: Glob patterns of additional config files to merge into this one.

cooldown_summary.description: Emit a summary alert when a rule is suppressed by its cooldown. Default: false.

rule_types.description: Restrict alerting to these rule types; unset means all types.

template_file.description: Path to a custom alert message template file.

label.description: Human-readable name used in logs and alert payloads.

rpc_url.description: Soroban RPC endpoint for this network.

explorer_url.description: Block explorer base URL used to build links in alert payloads.

passphrase.description: Network passphrase used when signing or decoding transactions.

network.description: Network name ("mainnet", "testnet", "futurenet") or an inline table with explicit endpoints.

soroban_rpc_url.description: Soroban RPC endpoint used for contract event lookups.

webhook_url.description: Shorthand for a single destination; described by the webhook_* fields.

webhook_secret.description: HMAC secret used to sign requests to the shorthand webhook_url destination.

webhook_format.description: Payload format for the shorthand webhook_url destination. Default: "txwatch".

webhook_headers.description: Extra HTTP headers for the shorthand webhook_url destination.

webhook_routing_key.description: PagerDuty routing key; required when webhook_format = "pagerduty".

webhooks.description: Additional webhook destinations. May be combined with webhook_url.

poll_interval_seconds.description: Per-contract poll interval override in seconds. Defaults to the top-level poll_interval_seconds.

batch_alerts.description: Deliver each poll cycle's alerts as one {"alerts": [...]} POST (split into batches of at most 50).

rules.description: Alert rules evaluated for this contract.

Severity.description: Minimum severity an alert must have to be delivered.

ReadinessPolicy.description: Controls which dependencies must be reachable before the watcher starts. Default: "strict".

WebhookHeaders.description: Extra HTTP headers; values support ${ENV_VAR}. Content-Type, Content-Length and X-TxWatch-* are reserved.

url.description: Destination URL that receives alert POSTs.

secret.description: HMAC secret used to sign requests to this destination (sent as the X-TxWatch-Signature header).

format.description: Payload format for this destination. Default: "txwatch".

headers.description: Extra HTTP headers sent with each request to this destination.

routing_key.description: PagerDuty routing key; required when format = "pagerduty".

tls_ca_file.description: Path to a PEM CA bundle used to verify this destination's TLS certificate.

tls_client_cert_file.description: Path to a PEM client certificate presented for mutual TLS to this destination.

tls_client_key_file.description: Path to the PEM private key matching tls_client_cert_file.

tls_insecure.description: When true, skip TLS certificate verification for this destination. Not recommended outside testing. Default: false.

threshold_xlm.description: Minimum transfer amount in XLM that triggers the alert.

args.description: Match invocation parameters by position; all entries must match.

function_names.description: Function names treated as administrative; any invocation of one triggers the alert.

threshold_stroops.description: Fee threshold in stroops; transactions at or above it trigger the alert.

threshold_xlm.description: Convenience fee threshold in XLM; converted to stroops and merged with threshold_stroops.

rule.description: Nested rule whose matches are counted.

count.description: Number of nested-rule matches required within the window to fire.

window_seconds.description: Length of the sliding window in seconds (max 7 days).

oneOf.description: Fires once per breach when the nested rule matches at least `count` times within a sliding `window_seconds` window.

memo_type.description: Restrict matching to a specific memo type.

oneOf.description: Matches the transaction memo; exactly one of `equals` or `prefix` is required.

issuer.description: Asset issuer account; when set, only transfers of this issuer's asset match.

min_amount.description: Minimum transfer amount in the asset's smallest unit.

argument_index.description: Zero-based position of the argument to inspect.

argument_value.description: Expected argument value (address, symbol, integer, or string).

topic.description: Optional topic filter; when set, only events whose first topic matches are considered.

args.description: Match invocation parameters by position; all entries must match.

oneOf.description: Fires once per breach when the nested rule matches at least `count` times within a sliding `window_seconds` window.
Matches the transaction memo; exactly one of `equals` or `prefix` is required.

topic.description: Positional topic patterns. Each pattern matches any scalar ScVal; a bare value matches its symbol/string form, and an optional type prefix (e.g. "address:G...", "u32:5", "symbol:transfer", "string:hello", "bool:true") constrains the ScVal type.

data.description: Matchers over the decoded event data (JSON). All matchers must hold. i128/u128 values are compared as integers.

index.description: Zero-based position in the invocation parameters.

eq.description: Expected value: address (G…/C…), symbol, integer, or string.

TransferDirection.description: For LargeTransfer: only count balance changes where the watched contract is the recipient ("in"), the sender ("out"), or either ("any").

ReadinessPolicy.description: How startup readiness checks behave: "strict" fails startup if any contract cannot be reached, "lenient" logs a warning and continues, and "disabled" skips readiness checks entirely.

Severity.description: Alert severity level, ordered info < warning < critical.

path.description: RFC 6901 JSON pointer into the decoded event data (e.g. "/amount", "/0/to"). Empty string refers to the whole data value.

op.description: Comparison operator. gte/lte require a numeric value.

value.description: Expected value: string, number, boolean or null. Numbers are compared as integers when the target is i128/u128.
